title: From Observation to Intervention: Distilling Self-Generated In-Context Demonstrations via Executable Causal Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.21149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-generated In-Context Learning (ICL) enables LLMs to synthesize their own few-shot demonstrations, often outperforming manual prompts. However, existing methods filter demonstrations by observation, assuming a rationale is high-quality if it leads to the correct output. We show such filtering suffers from \textit{observational equivalence}, whereby both faithful causal rationales and spurious post-hoc rationales can yield same outputs and are statistically indistinguishable from observation alone. Inspired by independent causal mechanisms, we argue that faithful rationales imply \textit{transfer invariance}, in which causal rationales should remain effective across logically similar samples. We instantiate this criterion as \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{I}ntervention for \textbf{D}emonstrations \textbf{D}istillation (ECI2D), which abstracts language rationales into executable programs and applies the causal intervention

translated_title: 从观察到干预：通过可执行因果干预蒸馏自生成的上下文演示
translated_abstract: 自生成的上下文学习使大语言模型能够合成自己的少样本演示，其效果通常优于人工设计的提示。然而，现有方法通过观察来筛选演示，假设只要推理依据能导向正确输出，它就是高质量的。我们证明这种筛选方式存在“观察等价性”问题：忠实的因果推理依据与虚假的事后推理依据都可能产生相同的输出，仅凭观察在统计上无法区分二者。受独立因果机制的启发，我们提出忠实的推理依据应具有“迁移不变性”，即因果推理依据应在逻辑相似的样本上保持有效。我们将这一准则实例化为可执行因果干预演示蒸馏（ECI2D），该方法将语言推理依据抽象为可执行程序，并应用因果干预
tldr: 该论文提出ECI2D方法，将自生成演示的推理依据抽象为可执行程序并进行因果干预，以克服传统观察式筛选中忠实因果推理与虚假推理无法区分的“观察等价性”问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ECI2D, which abstracts rationales of self-generated demonstrations into executable programs and applies causal intervention, overcoming the observational equivalence problem where faithful causal rationales and spurious post-hoc rationales are statistically indistinguishable from observation alone.
